_about: PT vs BR spelling divergences that remain VALID under AO1990 because they reflect a real difference in pronunciation between the European and Brazilian norms. These are NOT spelling errors to be 'fixed' — both members of each pair are correct, one per norm. The library treats them as a variant-conversion layer (ao1990-pt <-> ao1990-br), never as old->new normalisation.
_sources: Acordo Ortografico de 1990, Base I (open/closed stressed vowels) and Base IV (dual consonants, see base_iv.json)
_nasal_vowel_rule: Stressed open vowels e/o before nasal consonant (m/n): European norm writes acute (é/ó), Brazilian norm writes circumflex (ê/ô). This sub-rule is regular and is also applied generatively in rules.py (NasalVowelPTBR); the pairs below are the verified anchor set and the irregular lexical ones.
